cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancelling the party was sensible. Not telling me wasn't. Start your apology with that distinction, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That explains the decision, not the effect. I turned up with a cake. What were you expecting me to do with it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you had to carry it all the way home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closer. Now include the part where you knew I was coming and let me.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 fear of upsetting A prompts A3's cake consequence. B4 apologizes for carrying it home, which A5 accepts as closer but redirects to knowingly leaving A uninformed.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains a protective motive and B4 attempts an apology to a concrete inconvenience. B can plausibly miss the emotional point without becoming a nonsense feeder.

heightening.evidence: A5 treats B4's partial progress as a step in a supervised correction, insisting on the remaining concealment rather than adding another grievance.
